create.name: Burgs
create.bio:
Burgs is an English meditation teacher who founded The Art of Meditation and has led retreats for around twenty-five years. He spent many years practising in Asia, training in the jhana concentration practices under Pa Auk Sayadaw in Burma and receiving Dzogchen teachings from Dodrupchen Rinpoche in Sikkim, and came home to England when one of those teachers asked him to start teaching. His approach weaves samatha and vipassana with heart practices, energy work from what he calls internal alchemy, breath and movement, and he is known for guiding complete beginners and long-term practitioners side by side.

Much of his teaching is offered on a donation basis. He runs self-paced online courses that start with stillness and the basics of sitting, curated online programmes and weekend retreats, half-day workshops in London, and longer residential retreats, recently at a venue in northern Portugal, including occasional Dzogchen-based retreats for returning students. A podcast and a large YouTube channel carry his talks and guided meditations, and a Patreon community supports the work and gives members teachings and early retreat places. His guided meditations are also published on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Level 1: The Art of Meditation
courses.description: A twelve-lesson self-paced online course laying the foundations of his approach, from settling the mind to building a steady daily practice.

courses.title: The Stillness Programme
courses.description: An eight-lesson self-paced introduction to meditation for complete beginners, taken step by step at home.

courses.title: End of Year Energy Workshop with Burgs in London
courses.description: An afternoon in Wimbledon of movement meditation, breathwork and short talks, aimed at letting go of the year's build-up and resetting before the holidays.

courses.title: Heart Essence of the Awakened Mind
courses.description: A residential retreat in northern Portugal passing on the Dzogchen teachings he received from Dodrupchen Rinpoche, open to people who have sat with him before or completed his Love as the Path programme. Dates for 2027 to be confirmed.
courses.price: On donation (food and accommodation charged separately)

courses.title: Tibetan Thangka Art & Meditation Intensive Retreat
courses.description: A ten-day retreat in northern Portugal, co-led with thangka painter Carmen Mensink, combining meditation with learning to draw Buddha figures using traditional grids and proportions. Dates for 2027 to be confirmed.
courses.price: £1250 GBP twin / £1550 GBP single (food and accommodation)

courses.title: Burgs on Patreon
courses.description: A membership community supporting his largely donation-based teaching, with talks, discourses and resources, plus priority on retreat waiting lists.

free_resources.title: Burgs on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer profile, with guided meditations that are free to play.

free_resources.title: Taster Meditations
free_resources.description: Free guided audio meditations from his courses, including a twelve-minute stillness practice, mindfulness of the breath and a guided journey through the body.

free_resources.title: The Art of Meditation Podcast
free_resources.description: Free talks and live retreat recordings on meditation, consciousness and how to live well.
